tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a file in one call and get a download link. Pass name and content_text (or content_base64). Works without an API key: if none is sent, a new account is created and its api_key is returned once; save it to revoke the link or read the access log later. Default link: anyone with the link, expires

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create a Handoff account and return an API key once. No Authorization header is required. Save api_key. On later calls send Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass api_key only if you cannot set headers. share_file can create this key for you. The k

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save a private file for this account. Pass name and content_text or content_base64. Returns the file id and metadata. Does not share the file. Requires your API key.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List this account's files, newest first, up to 1000. Use this to find a file_id before sharing. Returns metadata only, never bytes or download URLs. Requires your API key.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Create a controlled download link for a file you own. Use this when a person or another agent should fetch the file. The response includes url and token ONCE, plus expires_at and max_opens. Save the url immediately. Later status calls do not return it. When expires_in_hours is omitted, the link expi

tools.name: get_share_status
tools.description: Read an owned grant: token_prefix (not the secret), audience, approval, expiry, revocation, and open_count. Does not download the file and does not return the share URL. Requires your API key.

tools.name: approve_share
tools.description: Approve an owned grant that was created with requires_approval. Opens stay blocked until this succeeds. Requires your API key.

tools.name: deny_share
tools.description: Deny an owned grant. A denied grant stays blocked. Requires your API key.

tools.name: revoke_share
tools.description: Permanently revoke an owned share. Later downloads fail. This cannot be undone and does not delete the file. Requires your API key.

tools.name: get_access_log
tools.description: Read the latest 1000 access attempts for an owned grant, including refused downloads. Use this to see whether a share was opened. Requires your API key.

tools.name: fetch_shared_file
tools.description: Download a file from a share url or token. Use this when you were given a Handoff url and need the bytes. Honors expiry, open limits, approval, and agent audience. anyone_with_link needs no key. An agent audience uses your API key. Files up to 1048576 bytes return content_base64, plus content_text w

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file you own. The bytes are removed and existing share links stop working. Requires your API key.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List grants you own. Pass file_id to limit the list to one file. Returns grant_id, status, open_count, max_opens, expires_at, and audience. Does not return tokens or download urls. Requires your API key.

tools.name: update_share
tools.description: Set when an owned share expires. expires_in_hours is measured from now. Example: 168 for 7 days. Does not return the token. Requires your API key.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_files, create_share_link, get_share_status, fetch_shared_file, list_shares · Private data: share_file, signup, save_file, list_files, create_share_link, get_share_status, approve_share, deny_share, revoke_share, get_access_log, fetch_shared_file, delete_file, list_shares, update_share · Public sink: share_file, signup, save_file, create_share_link, get_share_status, approve_share, deny_share, revoke_share, get_access_log, fetch_shared_file, delete_file, update_share · Destructive: revoke_share, delete_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_files, create_share_link, get_share_status, fetch_shared_file, list_shares · Private data: share_file, signup, save_file, list_files, create_share_link, get_share_status, approve_share, deny_share, revoke_share, get_access_log, fetch_shared_file, delete_file, list_shares, update_share · Public sink: share_file, signup, save_file, create_share_link, get_share_status, approve_share, deny_share, revoke_share, get_access_log, fetch_shared_file, delete_file, update_share · Destructive: revoke_share, delete_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
